limits: The designated hosted runners expose no SGX1 or EPC. The Intel SDK simulator and NeverD software enclave receipts qualify software execution.
The KVM save images represent the KVM32 and KVM64 SMM profiles. Bare-metal firmware and nested VMX/SVM SMM are separate environments.
The SGX execution owner imports initialized x64 SECS and TCS. Enclave construction and cryptographic leaves, CET and XSAVE components beyond AVX require additional platform state.
Asynchronous delivery uses explicitly supplied logical-processor events and APIC state. Device source timing and multi-processor routing belong to their producers.
